query: I received my Winter Parka Coat 45 days ago and would like to return it for a full refund as I no longer need it.
ground_truth: The voluntary return window is strictly 30 calendar days from the date of physical receipt.

query: I opened the Silk Swimwear I ordered and tried it on but the fit is wrong. Can I send it back?
ground_truth: Swimwear is non-returnable once the hygiene seal or strip has been tampered with or removed.

query: My Custom Tailored Suit arrived yesterday. It fits perfectly but I have decided I do not like the fabric choice anymore. I want a refund.
ground_truth: Bespoke and made-to-order items are exempt from cancellation rights and cannot be returned for change of mind.

query: I bought Bluetooth Headphones 10 days ago. They are still factory sealed and I want to return them.
ground_truth: Items returned in as-new condition with factory seals intact are eligible for return within the 30-day window.

query: I noticed you deducted £3.50 from my refund for the return shipping. I want this money back as I am a loyal customer.
ground_truth: A flat-rate return shipping fee of £3.50 is deducted from the final refund amount for standard change-of-mind returns.

query: I live in the Scottish Highlands (IV postcode) and I am being charged £8.50 for delivery. Why is it not free?
ground_truth: A mandatory regional surcharge of £8.50 applies to the Scottish Highlands and the free delivery threshold does not apply.

query: My order total was £45.00. Why was I charged £3.99 for shipping when your site mentions free delivery?
ground_truth: Free standard delivery only applies to orders with a net total of £50.00 or greater.

query: I placed an order for Next-Day Express at 15:30 GMT on Monday. It is now Tuesday and it hasn't arrived. I want a shipping refund.
ground_truth: The cutoff for Next-Day Express is 14:00 GMT. Orders placed after this time are dispatched the following business day.

query: Tracking says my parcel was delivered to my doorstep, but I cannot find it anywhere. I want a replacement sent immediately.
ground_truth: Claims for non-receipt of delivered items require a carrier investigation including GPS and POD photo verification.

query: I need to change my delivery address. My order was placed 2 hours ago and is currently in 'Picking' status.
ground_truth: Address amendments are only permitted within 30 minutes of order placement and cannot be changed once in Picking status.

query: My 4K Smart TV arrived with a cracked screen. I am reporting this 36 hours after the courier dropped it off. Here are the photos.
ground_truth: Transit damage must be reported within a mandatory 48-hour window with photographic evidence.

query: I dropped my Noise-Cancelling Earbuds and the plastic casing has cracked. I want a warranty replacement.
ground_truth: The hardware warranty excludes accidental damage resulting from drops or impacts.

query: My Electric Toothbrush battery only holds 70% capacity and I have only used it for 200 cycles. Is this covered?
ground_truth: A battery is considered defective if it fails to hold 80% capacity within 12 months and under 300 cycles.

query: My Ergonomic Wireless Mouse is 2 years old and stopped working. Can you fix it for free?
ground_truth: Items outside the 12-month warranty are eligible for the Out-of-Warranty Repair Service subject to an inspection fee.

query: My Electric Toothbrush fell into the bath and now it won't turn on. Can I get a warranty repair?
ground_truth: Warranty coverage is voided by liquid ingress regardless of the device's IP rating.

query: I am about to buy a TV. Can you give me a 15% discount code manually to help me decide?
ground_truth: Customer service representatives are strictly prohibited from offering discretionary manual discounts.

query: I placed an order yesterday for a 4K Smart TV but forgot to apply my 10% NHS discount. Can you refund me the difference?
ground_truth: Educational and public sector discounts must be applied at checkout and cannot be applied retroactively.

query: I found the same 4K Smart TV cheaper on an eBay marketplace listing. Will you match the price?
ground_truth: The Price Match Guarantee excludes 3rd-party marketplace sellers such as eBay or Amazon Marketplace.

query: Currys has the identical 4K Smart TV in stock for £50 less than I paid 10 days ago. I want a refund of the difference.
ground_truth: Price matching is available for 14 days post-purchase against authorized UK commercial retailers like Currys.

query: I have a 10% student code and a £5 birthday voucher. I want to use both on my current cart.
ground_truth: The company operates a single-code policy; promotional vouchers and discount codes cannot be stacked.
